(Image credit: EA) Copy link Facebook X Pinterest Flipboard Email Share this article 0 Join the conversation Follow us Add us as a preferred source on Google Newsletter Subscribe to our newsletter Following the unpopular closure of BioWare and cancellation of Mass Effect 5 , project director Mike Gamble has taken time to thank fans for their outpouring of support. Taking to Twitter , Gamble says the support has been appreciated and has encouraged anyone hiring to look out for his team, which he says is full of "OGs" - perhaps in the off chance people doubt that some of the talent behind BioWare 's greatest hits are still at the studio. "I could probably scroll for hours and continue reading the words of support for the studio, the legacy, and the impact that BioWare has had on you," he says. "It means so much to us. There is so much talent on this team of OGs, so if you are aware of any roles, please send them. I will personally vouch for everyone in my crew." Latest Videos From GamesRadar+ Watch full video here: Not content with ending on a somber note, Gamble offers some humor before signing off. "At least I don't have to call in sick when GTA 6 comes out." Sadly, BioWare was caught in that crossfire, with the studio shut down and work on Mass Effect 5 scrapped. Many developers across the industry have expressed sadness , and those who worked on Mass Effect 5 said it was "something special." And special it looked. Not long after the news broke, rumors of a trailer surfaced, only for that very Mass Effect 5 trailer to leak online. What could have been, man.
